mission: Adversarial audit, defect eradication, and visual proof for Schedule & Reception cluster (#schedule, appointment cards, chair palette toolbar, mobile agenda, booking drawer).
invariants_enforced: Mandate 8e: Doctor & Staff Autonomy (zero disabled primary buttons, optional assistant, 1-click duration & reason presets)
7 Deadly Sins of UI: 1-row toolbar budget, <=2 primary interactive controls per appointment card, zero word slicing/ellipsis clipping
Apple iOS HIG & Mobile Ergonomics (>=44x44px touch targets, Natural Thumb Zone, unblocked bottom navigation)
Zero Mocks Law: Live PostgreSQL 18.4 on 5432, Fastify API on 4100, Vite dev server on 5173
Burden of Proof & Mandatory Pixel Inspection: Direct multimodal view_file inspection of all 6 live screenshots

mobile_name_truncation.defect: Patient patronymic slicing on 390px screens: 'Ковалёв Роман Станиславо...' caused by 3-line clamp with hard word-break next to wide status badge.
mobile_name_truncation.resolution: Applied formatPatientDisplayFio ('Ковалёв Роман С.') with title={fullPatientName}, updated CSS to -webkit-line-clamp: 2, overflow-wrap: break-word, min-width: 0.

mobile_bottom_bar_tour_occlusion.defect: Desktop tour invite banner (390px wide) appeared on mobile viewport, covering bottom navigation tabs [Расписание | Пациенты | Приём | Касса | Ещё].
mobile_bottom_bar_tour_occlusion.resolution: Added window.innerWidth <= 768 guard in useEffect and hidden md:block CSS wrapper to guarantee zero mobile tab occlusion per Apple HIG.

filter_strip_chair_chip_boundary_cutoff.defect: Date input was locked to w-[135px] min-w-[135px] and !important 130px in CSS, starving chair filter chips container and cutting off 2nd chair chip ('Каб...').
filter_strip_chair_chip_boundary_cutoff.resolution: Reduced date input to w-[102px] min-w-[102px] and CSS width: 102px !important; tightened queue tab padding to px-1.5 sm:px-2, completely freeing container space.

chair_palette_toolbar_squeeze.defect: Label 'Стоматологические установки:' (180px), redundant room labels ('Кабинет 1 (Терапия) (Каб. 1)'), and 4 right-side buttons squeezed chair chips to '• Ка...'.
chair_palette_toolbar_squeeze.resolution: Shifted label to hidden 2xl:inline; sanitized chair chip names to cleanChairTitle ('Каб. 1', 'Каб. 2') and omitted redundant (Каб. X); shortened shift button text to 'Смены...' on <2xl; collapsed roster and add-doctor buttons to 'Ещё...' on <2xl.

appointment_card_control_landfill.defect: Resting appointment card rendered 4 buttons simultaneously (DentalPRO realtime bar, status badge trigger, more menu, [В приём]).
appointment_card_control_landfill.resolution: Conditionally rendered dentalpro-realtime-bar only when isHovered || densityMode === 'expanded', strictly keeping <=2 interactive controls on resting cards.

verification.typecheck: PASS (npx tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit exited with code 0)
verification.live_database_backend: PASS (Live PostgreSQL 18.4, Fastify on 4100, Vite on 5173, seedLiveScheduleData with 4 real appointments and 2 chairs)
